variants.name: board
variants.prompt: Create ONE modular wooden wall-shelf BOARD sprite for Pixel’s World, cozy warm autumn 2D pixel-art side-view game. Only the horizontal wooden board, NO brackets, no objects or books. Warm aged medium oak, muted golden tan top edge, dark warm brown front lip and bottom edge, 3-4 broad pixel color clusters with restrained wood grain and one tiny knot. Exact flat orthographic front/side game elevation, long horizontal rectangle. Design in a 48x8 logical pixel canvas, entire silhouette fills width 48 and height8, straight level top edge across whole width. Outer left8 and right8 logical pixel sections form matching short wooden end caps; central32 pixels are clean repeatable wood-grain front face. No projecting front corners, perspective, isometric depth or angled ends. Every vertical cross-section should have same thickness. The game will use separate left8x8 and right8x8 sections and a repeatable central8x8 sample to support arbitrary shelf widths without stretching the caps. This is a tiny platform top, crisp chunky square pixels matching a muted olive cozy sofa and rust curtain. Return the single entire board enlarged with nearest-neighbor-looking pixel blocks, genuine transparent alpha exterior, no diffuse halo, black matte, floor shadow, text, watermark, surrounding room, extra pieces or UI. Keep broad readable details at original48x8 size.

Design for an 8x8 logical pixel canvas displayed at2x: LEFT edge is flat vertical and full-height to join the existing shelf board texture seamlessly; top and bottom are level until the last3 logical columns, where several long irregular jagged wood splinters project right at different lengths, with transparent gaps between their tips. Exposed fracture is pale warm raw wood with dark cracks, outer front face warm reddish oak, thin golden top edge and dark brown bottom edge matching reference. Full board thickness spans the entire8 logical pixels, NOT a thin stick or pottery shard. Crisp very chunky square pixel clusters, broad flat warm brown/tan colors, no perspective, no brackets, nails, books, extra objects, text or labels.
